citation: Yan B, Boitano M, Clark TA, Ettwiller L (2018) Nature Communications 9:3676. SMRT-Cappable-seq reveals complex operon variants in bacteria.
datasetVersion: Supplementary Data 2 (41467_2018_5997_MOESM5_ESM.xlsx; sheet SMRT-Cappable-seq Operon), article published 2018-09-10, retrieved 2026-09-16; ends derived from the last listed gene; gene symbols and current locus tags from the NCBI RefSeq NC_000913.3 GenBank file (LOCUS date 09-DEC-2025); one record per strand and gene set

notes: Records: 2335 of 3070 published rows; 1264 name two or more genes. THE 3' END IS NOT MEASURED: Supplementary Data 2 publishes a gene list, a start site and a strand only, so each unit's far edge is the end of the last gene it lists (attributes.endEvidence = 'gene-derived'); the start site is measured. Ends are therefore systematically short of the biological transcript end, and short of the operon end where the paper's size-selected library truncated a long operon. Measured ends from Supplementary Data 1 are deliberately NOT substituted: they lie inside the derived span for about a third of the rows that have one, because the two tables were built from different transcripts, and a unit whose box excludes its own genes is worse than a uniformly conservative end. Dropped: 15 rows naming a b-number with no current locus tag or synonym in the GenBank file (b0077|b0078|b0079, b0077|b0078|b0079|b0080, b0103|b0102|b0101|b0100); 0 rows whose derived span was empty. Kept with a caveat: 48 rows whose measured start lies inside their first listed gene, an internal start site; the honest measured start is kept rather than stretched to cover that gene. 720 further rows shared a gene set with a kept row and were merged onto its most upstream start site, their start sites kept in attributes.alternativeStartsBp. 13 retired b-numbers were replaced by the current locus tag that lists them as /gene_synonym in the GenBank file (b0255->b4587, b0257->b4587, b1016->b4490, b1017->b4490, b1405->b4492, b1416->b4493, b1417->b4493, b1509->b4696, b2090->b4498, b2999->b4658, b3000->b4658, b3767->b4488, b3768->b4488); a list that then named the same locus twice keeps it once. 8 published b-numbers have no current locus tag or synonym and are kept as published, with the b-number as the gene symbol (b0079, b0100, b0165, b0725, b1052, b1903, b3036, b4250). No score: Supplementary Data 2 carries no per-unit number, and its columns 4-5 are a RegulonDB comparison that is never read. No conditions: the table pools M9 and rich medium without labels. Supplementary Data 3 (re-published RegulonDB operons) is never downloaded.
